doc_sources.note: ROBOTS-BLOCKED FOR OUR FETCHER. Denis's ruling 2026-08-20: reachable by a human, or by an independent Playwright session run deliberately outside the pipeline -- never by the automated fetcher. Authored as kind:"portal" precisely because DISCOVER only ever prefills a manual task from a portal source and never enqueues fetch.url for it. Both www.coltene.com and media.coltene.com serve a Cloudflare managed robots.txt naming `User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /` AND `User-agent: CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler / Disallow: /` -- the operator has explicitly refused headless-browser rendering as well as plain crawling, so an earlier HTTP 403 was that policy being enforced rather than a bug. NOT FETCHED, NOT RENDERED. Their content signal does say `use=reference`, which suggests an email asking permission may well succeed where scraping is barred. The media library reportedly takes a per-article parameter (index?q={article_number}) which would be a high-value per-item lookup, but that shape is UNTESTED and must come from asking Coltene, not from assuming. Legal entity per their own product PDFs is Coltene/Whaledent AG, Altstaetten, Switzerland -- a Swiss entity, so the EU-side MDR actor is likely a different legal person and is NOT authored here.
